UK Chancellor John Healey May Raise Taxes on Bank Profits

UK Chancellor John Healey is reportedly considering increasing taxes on banks' profits as part of his upcoming budget. This potential move aims to generate revenue to help offset the financial impact of the Iran war on public finances. The proposal targets the banking sector's 'bumper profits'.
